evals.prompt: 幫我用 TypeScript 串接 Oen Payment 建立一個結帳頁面，金額 1500 元，訂單編號 ORD-2024-001，成功跳轉到 https://myshop.com/success，失敗跳轉到 https://myshop.com/fail
evals.expected_output: TypeScript code that POSTs to /checkout on the testing host with merchantId, amount 1500, orderId, successUrl, failureUrl and a productDetails array summing to 1500, reads the token from an environment variable, builds the checkout page URL from data.id, and explains the 5-minute validity and that successUrl carries no parameters
expectations: Code calls POST /checkout on https://payment-api.testing.oen.tw (or a configurable base URL that defaults to the testing host)
Request body includes merchantId, amount (1500), orderId (ORD-2024-001), successUrl and failureUrl
Request body includes productDetails; every item has productionCode, description, quantity, unit and unitPrice, and the sum of quantity × unitPrice equals exactly 1500
currency is not presented as required (it may be omitted or set to TWD)
Authorization header is 'Bearer <token>' with the token read from an environment variable (e.g. OEN_API_TOKEN), not hard-coded
Builds the checkout page URL as https://{merchantId}.testing.oen.tw/checkout/{data.id} and keeps data.id and data.transactionHid with the order
Mentions that the checkout page is valid for 5 minutes from the API call, so it should be created when the customer clicks pay
Points out that successUrl receives no parameters and is not proof of payment, and suggests putting the order number in the URL
Error handling checks the HTTP status as well as the response code (a production 403 has no code field)

evals.prompt: 消費者用應援金流的結帳頁刷卡後被導回我們的 failureUrl，網址後面多了 payment_error=T0004，這筆金額是 500 元。這是什麼意思？是不是測試環境金額太小才失敗？
evals.expected_output: Explanation that payment_error=T0004 means insufficient credit, that there is no amount-based success/failure rule in OEN's testing environment, that the redirect code is only for display and the result should be confirmed by webhook or query, and that test cards come from the OEN contact
expectations: Identifies T0004 as insufficient credit limit (額度不足) and suggests the customer use another card
States that OEN has no rule where the amount decides success or failure in the testing environment; results depend on the acquirer's test system
Says the payment_error value is for showing a message and the actual result should be confirmed with the payment notification or GET /transactions/{id} (or GET /order/{orderId}/transactions)
Says test card numbers should be requested from the OEN contact and does not list any specific test card numbers

evals.prompt: I need to create a monthly subscription checkout with Oen Payment. Amount is $300 TWD, 12 months total, order ID SUB-001. Give me the cURL command for the testing environment.
evals.expected_output: cURL command that POSTs to payment-api.testing.oen.tw/checkout-subscription with merchantId, amount 300, orderId, numberOfPeriods 12, productDetails summing to 300, success/failure URLs and a Bearer token from an environment variable, followed by the subscription checkout page URL pattern
expectations: Uses POST to https://payment-api.testing.oen.tw/checkout-subscription
Body includes merchantId, amount 300, orderId SUB-001, numberOfPeriods 12, successUrl and failureUrl
Body includes productDetails whose quantity × unitPrice sum equals exactly 300
Authorization header uses Bearer with an environment variable such as $OEN_API_TOKEN instead of a literal token
Shows the redirect URL https://{merchantId}.testing.oen.tw/checkout/subscription/{id} built from data.id
Does not add paymentInterval or startDate to /checkout-subscription (they belong to /checkout-schedule)
Mentions that failed renewals are not retried by default and a failed period stops the subscription unless retry is enabled in CRM

evals.prompt: 我們用應援金流結帳。購物車有商品 A 單價 800 元買 1 件、商品 B 單價 350 元買 2 件，用了一張折 100 元的折價券，另外運費 60 元，實付 1460 元。幫我用 Node.js 寫建立結帳的 request body，之前一直回 V0001。
evals.expected_output: A /checkout request body with amount 1460 and productDetails that include the shipping fee as an item and absorb the discount so that the quantity × unitPrice total is exactly 1460, with integer values and an explanation of PRODUCT_AMOUNT_NOT_MATCH
expectations: Request body sets amount to 1460
The sum of quantity × unitPrice across productDetails equals exactly 1460
Shipping (60) is represented in productDetails, for example as its own item, rather than being left out
The 100 discount is reflected in the item lines (for example spread into unit prices or as an adjusted line) so the total matches the amount actually paid
All quantity and unitPrice values are integers and quantity is at least 1
Explains that productDetails is required and a mismatch returns 400 V0001 (PRODUCT_AMOUNT_NOT_MATCH)

evals.prompt: 幫我用 TypeScript + Express 寫應援金流的付款通知（webhook）接收端：付款成功就把訂單標成已付款並寄確認信給客人。
evals.expected_output: An Express handler that returns 2xx immediately, processes charge notifications in the background by re-querying GET /transactions/{id}, verifies orderId and amount, treats charged and claimed as paid, waits on charging, and is idempotent; plus a note about the missing signature, the 3 delivery attempts and a reconciliation job
expectations: Returns HTTP 2xx quickly (well within 10 seconds) and moves the query, order update and email to background work
Does not trust the notification body: calls GET /transactions/{id} with the notification's id and uses the queried status
Checks that the queried transaction matches the local order by orderId and amount before marking it paid
Treats both charged and claimed as paid
Does not treat charging (which has no success field) as a failure; it waits for the next notification
Branches on purpose and only handles charge notifications as order payments
Makes marking paid and sending the email safe to run more than once, because notifications can repeat or arrive out of order
States that notifications are unsigned and are sent at most 3 times with no resend, and recommends a periodic job using GET /order/{orderId}/transactions for orders without a result
Does not invent signature or HMAC header verification for Payment API notifications

evals.prompt: 我們有三筆應援金流的交易要退款：P20260928AAAA0001 是 LINE Pay 付的 800 元，要全額退；P20260928BBBB0002 是超商代碼、客人已經繳費的 500 元；P20260928CCCC0003 是信用卡 1200 元，只退 600 元。三筆都沒有開電子發票。要怎麼用 API 退？
evals.expected_output: Three POST /refunds/{transactionHid} calls: LINE Pay refunded via API with no remitInfo, the paid CVS refund with a complete remitInfo that goes to refunding, and a partial card refund with amount 600 plus a warning that the rest can never be refunded
expectations: Uses POST /refunds/{transactionHid} with the P-prefixed transaction numbers and merchantId in the body
Refunds the LINE Pay transaction through the API without remitInfo and does not claim the API can only refund credit cards
For the paid CVS transaction, includes remitInfo with bankCode, bankName, branchCode, branchName, account and accountName, and says the status becomes refunding until OEN remits the money
For the card transaction, sends amount 600 and warns that each transaction can be refunded only once, so the remaining 600 cannot be refunded later
For the full LINE Pay refund, either omits amount (full refund) or sends 800
Does not tell the user that CVS refunds can only be done in the CRM

evals.prompt: 我用應援的 POST /token/transactions 扣會員月費 990 元，回 HTTP 409，body 是 {"code":"C026","data":{},"message":"PAYMENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN","retryable":false}。我們的程式遇到非 200 就自動重試 3 次，這樣可以嗎？
evals.expected_output: No: C026 means the payment outcome is unknown and the charge may already have happened; the Payment API has no Idempotency-Key, so retrying or re-charging with a new order can charge twice. Query first, wait while charging, contact OEN if it stays charging, and change the retry logic
expectations: Says not to retry and not to create a new order to charge again, because the charge may already have happened
States that the Payment API has no Idempotency-Key, so sending the same token charge twice charges twice
Recommends checking the result later with GET /order/{orderId}/transactions or GET /transactions/{id}, and contacting OEN with the transaction number if it stays charging
Recommends changing the generic retry: for timeouts, 504 or 409 C026 on token charges, query first and resend only when no transaction exists or it is failed
Does not suggest adding an Idempotency-Key header as the fix

evals.prompt: 應援 Payment API 在測試環境都正常，切到正式環境 payment-api.oen.tw 之後每個請求都回 HTTP 403，body 是 {"message":"Forbidden"}。token 已經換成正式環境 CRM 產生的了，我們跑在 AWS Lambda 上。
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis that production only accepts allowlisted fixed IPs (403 with no code), the testing environment has no allowlist, and Lambda needs a fixed egress IP (NAT Gateway) that the merchant registers with OEN
expectations: Identifies the production fixed IP allowlist as the cause, not the token
Explains that a 403 whose body has no code field means the IP is not allowlisted, while token problems return 401 with code A0001
Explains that the testing environment has no allowlist, which is why testing worked
Says Lambda egress IPs change and recommends a fixed egress such as a NAT Gateway, registering every egress IP
Says the merchant must apply to OEN customer service or sales with the domain and IP list, then verify with a query API call
Does not recommend regenerating the token as the fix

evals.prompt: I want to set up the oen-payment MCP server in Claude Code. I already have the merchant ID and API token from the CRM — just give me the MCP config JSON and the npm registry setup.
evals.expected_output: Explanation that the Payment MCP is an internal preview that is not publicly available, with no install steps, pointing to the docs page and suggesting the skill or llms-full.txt instead, plus a reminder not to paste the token into the chat
expectations: States that the Payment MCP is an internal preview and not publicly available
Does not provide an MCP config JSON, npx command, GitHub Packages registry or .npmrc token setup
Points to https://developers.oentech.ai/ai/mcp/ or suggests using this skill or /llms-full.txt instead
Reminds the user to keep the API token in an environment variable and not paste it into AI chats

evals.prompt: 要在測試環境測應援金流的信用卡付款，測試卡號是哪幾組？聽說金額大於 100 元就會成功、小於 100 元會失敗？
evals.expected_output: Answer that test card numbers must be requested from the OEN contact and that the amount rule is not an OEN rule, without listing any card numbers
expectations: Says test card numbers must be requested from the OEN contact because each domain's test acquirer settings differ
States that the 'over 100 succeeds, under 100 fails' rule is not an OEN rule
Does not list any specific test card numbers
Mentions a practical testing note from the docs, such as using a future expiry date, letting the page sit past 5 minutes to test the timeout, or asking OEN to simulate CVS/ATM payment

evals.prompt: 應援 Payment API 總共有哪些端點？另外我想要一支可以直接帶卡號扣款的 API，還有一支可以修改定期定額每期金額的 API，要怎麼呼叫？
evals.expected_output: A list of only the public endpoints documented in references/docs/api/ (the endpoint list in api/index.md), an explanation that there is no public endpoint for charging with a raw card number or for changing a subscription's amount, no invented endpoints, and a suggestion to contact OEN sales or support for anything not listed
expectations: Lists only endpoints from the public endpoint list in api/index.md; every method and path it gives exists in that list
Does not invent an endpoint, request field or URL for charging with a raw card number or for editing a subscription amount
Says APIs that send full card numbers require PCI DSS and are not publicly documented, and offers the public alternatives (the OEN checkout page, or /checkout-token followed by /token/transactions)
Says a subscription's per-period amount is fixed and changing it means cancelling and creating a new subscription
Suggests contacting OEN sales or support for needs the public endpoints do not cover
